mu_name_from: aida's object slot: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd, from Data/Object34.
sheet_from: Data/Object34/, decoded under the ai_ prefix by `mu new`.
material_note: sunlight2_R: soft grey vertical shafts on black, added.
why_this_one: A sunbeam slanting through the canopy, 21 of them, mostly along the west edge and the south-east. Glow batch (the user, 2026-10-11: 'Glow sheets batch'). docs/aida-port.md.
additive_from: An _R sheet: MU's TextureScript marks a name with _R after its underscore bright (TextureScript.cpp:16-58) and RenderBody makes that mesh the blend mesh (ZzzBMD.cpp:2236-2242), so it is drawn added, as Tarkan's chogatea02_R.
glow_from: MoveAidaObject type 41 sets Alpha 0.5 (GMAida.cpp:72-76) and RenderAidaObjectVisual draws mesh 0 again RENDER_TEXTURE|RENDER_BRIGHT at BodyLight 0.52 (:151-165): two added passes of a half-strength beam, about one full one. So one added pass, steady at 1.0.
effects_note: The second bright pass is folded into the one glow.
